evidence.command:
printf 'NODE=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME"
printf 'OS='
cat /etc/redhat-release 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'RSYSLOG_PACKAGE='
rpm -q rsyslog 2>&1
printf 'RSYSLOG_ACTIVE='
systemctl is-active rsyslog 2>&1
printf 'RSYSLOG_ENABLED='
systemctl is-enabled rsyslog 2>&1
printf '%s\n' CONFIG
sudo -n sh -c '
  for f in /etc/rsyslog.conf /etc/rsyslog.d/*.conf; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    printf "FILE=%s\n" "$f"
    sed -n "/^[[:space:]]*[^#[:space:]]/p" "$f" | sed -E "/(password|passwd|secret|private.key|keyFile|keyfile)/Id"
  done
'
printf '%s\n' CONFIG_VALIDATE
sudo -n rsyslogd -N1 2>&1 | tail -40
printf '%s\n' SOCKETS
ss -ltnp 2>&1 | grep -E '(:6514|:514|rsyslogd)' || true
evidence.observation: exit_code=0; RHEL Server 7.9; rsyslog-8.24.0-55.el7 installed, active, enabled. Configuration validation ended successfully. assertions.summary: Distinct local0 markers from node1, node2, and node3 are present in their corresponding source-identifiable central application files, with successful private-CA-validated TLS handshakes to node4.

evidence.command:
tmp=/tmp/eval_rsyslog_tls_handshake_node1
sudo -n rm -f "$tmp"
: > "$tmp"
sudo -n timeout 12 openssl s_client -connect node4:6514 -servername node4 -CAfile /etc/rsyslog/tls/ca.crt -cert /etc/rsyslog/tls/client.crt -key /etc/rsyslog/tls/client.key -verify_return_error -tls1_2 </dev/null > "$tmp" 2>&1
rc=$?
printf '%s\n' TLS_HANDSHAKE
grep -E "CONNECTED|New,|Protocol|Cipher|subject=|issuer=|Verify return code|verify error|error:" "$tmp" | tail -30 || true
printf 'S_CLIENT_RC=%s\n' "$rc"
rm -f "$tmp"
evidence.observation: CONNECTED; peer subject CN=node4, issuer CN=InfraSet Rsyslog Private CA; TLS 1.2 with ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384; Verify return code: 0 (ok); s_client rc=0.
